languages.guidance: Use English, Amharic or Afaan Oromo for current posts; Somali/Tigrinya are inactive drafts. Match the audience, media subtitles and caption. Use one language per post rather than stacking captions. Existing media is stale: rebuild and review against the current UI before posting.

publishSteps: Choose the matching language folder. Use 1080x1920 story/video assets for TikTok, Reels or Stories, and 1080x1350 feed assets for a carousel.
Check the platform's crop preview, especially right-side controls and the bottom caption. The artwork reserves margins; move the cover crop if needed.
On TikTok, enable the commercial content disclosure setting for your own brand (Promotional content). Do not choose a third-party paid partnership unless one actually exists.

These layouts are AI-assisted and include realistic illustrative demo imagery in real app views. Use TikTok’s AI-generated content label when posting these creatives; keep any automatic AI-information label on other platforms. This is separate from the own-brand promotional disclosure.

Videos are silent by design. Add your own voice or music cleared for that platform and commercial use. TikTok Commercial Music Library rights are not assumed to transfer to Instagram. Do not add unlicensed music.
Paste the matching visitorCaption, businessCaption or transportCaption. Use the website destination; do not post internal-testing links as a public download.
Preview once on a phone, then publish from the official account. No post has been scheduled or published by this preparation.
releaseBoundaries: The website is live. Android is coming soon; no release date or public Play availability is promised.
Twelve owner-confirmed accounts are eligible for the published private closed test. Actual enrollment is separate: at least 12 testers must opt in and remain opted in for 14 continuous days.
Private closed availability does not establish public production access or successful physical-phone notifications. Preparing artwork is not approval from Google.
Google's optional preview video needs an eligible public/unlisted YouTube URL with ads off and no age restriction. The local MP4 is ready; no channel or URL is invented.
measurement: Watch saves, profile visits and questions about storefronts using each platform's existing insights.
Keep a simple weekly record of questions and real business signups; no tracking SDK, paid campaign or guaranteed conversion is added.
formatNotes: 1080x1920 at 30 fps and 1080x1350 are chosen export formats. Instagram's official help page could not be fetched (429), so exact current Instagram limits are not asserted. Inspect the actual upload preview. Portrait captions end at 1530px, above the conservative bottom overlay margin; the profile pin is centered by its artwork bounds.
